FX-EYEFILL-001.says: The settings as they start: the point in the middle, (8, 5), radius 0, Skip Empty: the skin under the point fills the whole layer, its line, shadow and empty border alike, all opaque.

FX-EYEFILL-002.says: The point at (2, 5), radius 2, Skip Empty: twelve pixels, two of them empty and left out, the soft edge's line counted at its full colour; a dark colour, mostly the line's, a little skin.

FX-EYEFILL-003.says: The same area, All: the two empty pixels count as black, so a little darker than FX-EYEFILL-002.

FX-EYEFILL-004.says: The same area, All Premultiplied: the soft edge counts at half, so darker again, still opaque.

FX-EYEFILL-005.says: The same area, Including Alpha: the area's covering, about two thirds, becomes the layer's; the colour that of FX-EYEFILL-004 divided by it.

FX-EYEFILL-006.says: FX-EYEFILL-005 with Maintain Original Alpha: the covering also times each pixel's own, so the border stays empty and the soft edge half again.

FX-EYEFILL-007.says: FX-EYEFILL-002 with Maintain Original Alpha: the colour opaque inside the cel, half covering on its soft edge, the border empty.

FX-EYEFILL-008.says: The settings as they start, Blend With Original 50: half way from the skin to the cel, the empty border half covered with skin.

FX-EYEFILL-009.says: Blend With Original 100: the cel as it was.

FX-EYEFILL-010.says: The point on the edge between skin and shadow, (10, 5), radius 1.5: four pixels, two each, an even mix of the two.

FX-EYEFILL-011.says: Radius 1000, Skip Empty: every pixel that shows, each at its full colour, averaged; the layer's empty pixels and the plane past it left out.

FX-EYEFILL-012.says: Radius 1000, All: the disc's three million pixels counted, nearly all past the layer and black, so the fill is all but black.

FX-EYEFILL-013.says: The point past the layer's left edge, (-50, 50), Skip Empty: nothing shows there, so black, opaque.

FX-EYEFILL-014.says: The same point, Including Alpha: nothing shows, so the layer is empty.

FX-EYEFILL-015.says: A radius of 0.4 with the point at (8.5, 5.5), a pixel's centre: that pixel alone, as radius 0, FX-EYEFILL-001's frame.

FX-EYEFILL-016.says: The point keyed from (25, 50) at frame 0 to (75, 50) at frame 4: skin at frames 0 and 2, shadow at frame 4.

FX-EYEFILL-017.says: The radius keyed from 0 to 4 at the edge point: the colour changes as the area grows.

FX-EYEFILL-018.says: Blend With Original keyed from 0 to 100: frame 0 FX-EYEFILL-001's, frame 2 FX-EYEFILL-008's, frame 4 the cel.

FX-EYEFILL-019.says: FX-EYEFILL-001 moved three pixels right: the layer's own pixels move, the three columns it left are empty.

FX-EYEFILL-020.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the point is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-EYEFILL-010's.

FX-EYEFILL-021.says: Blend With Original keyed from 40 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2, the cel.

FX-EYEFILL-022.says: Including Alpha, Maintain Original Alpha and Blend With Original 50 together at the edge point, radius 2.

FX-EYEFILL-023.says: All Premultiplied, Maintain Original Alpha, radius 0 on the soft edge at (1.5, 5.5): the line at half its colour, laid on each pixel's own covering.

FX-EYEFILL-024.says: Sample Point across 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-025.says: Sample Point down -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-026.says: Sample Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-027.says: Sample Radius 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-028.says: Blend With Original -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-029.says: Blend With Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-030.says: Average Pixel Colors "sum", not one of the four. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-031.says: Maintain Original Alpha "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EYEFILL-032.says: Blend With Original keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
